abstract_evidence_excerpt: Anaerobic co-digestion (AcoD) and reliable pretreatment methods are highly beneficial to valorizing waste into valuable biogas production because of the balanced substrate stoichiometry and sufficient recalcitrance. The latest advancements in pretreatment methods—biological hydrolysis, steam explosion, and microaeration—were discussed.
